text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Th-Thank you so much! ...Did you 
know? That today's my birthday—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I didn't know. I just happened to see them 
carrying a present a moment ago.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I see... Still, it's an honor. I 
never imagined I'd receive birthday wishes 
from you, Ramonu-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Did you think... I had no interest in you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Someday, I'll become the greatest 
Umamusume— one so amazing that even if you 
wanted to look away, you wouldn't be able 
to.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
So, when that time comes, will you 
congratulate me again? —Once I'm wearing 
the tiara.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Such a clever child when it comes to 
begging.
